description: The line plot illustrates the loss reduction over training time for two methods: Vanilla and SepLLM, with the x-axis representing training time in seconds (from 0 to 250,000) and the y-axis showing the loss value (ranging from 2.40 to 2.75). The Vanilla method is represented by a purple line with triangle markers, starting at a loss of approximately 2.75 at 0 seconds and steadily decreasing to around 2.50 by 250,000 seconds. The SepLLM method is shown with a red line and circular markers, beginning at a loss of about 2.70 and decreasing to approximately 2.49 by the end of the training period. A green dashed horizontal line at a loss of 2.50 is included as a reference, and a shaded rectangular region between 200,000 and 250,000 seconds highlights a specific interval on the x-axis. Both methods show a general downward trend in loss, with SepLLM achieving a lower final loss value compared to Vanilla.
